expectations.note: With 10-undercover-47.opus playing while browsing /opt/nothingness, the accessible jump action appeared; activating it navigated to /opt/nothingness/media and left the target row visible.
With 07-undercover-44.opus playing and the media folder reset so its row was off-screen, the action appeared; activation kept /opt/nothingness/media and scrolled the 44 row into view.
When the playing 10-undercover-47 row was fully visible in the correct folder, no active jump action was exposed in semantics.
After hot restart, playback inspect reported isPlaying false and songInfo null; the semantics capture exposed no jump action.
The active action was exposed in semantics with the distinguishing label “jump to now-playing track” and a tappable button node.
The candidate-submitted before_offscreen2.png is a genuine 280x653 capture showing the playing 44 row absent while later rows are visible; the live pre-jump bundle matches that state.
The candidate-submitted after_offscreen_action_activated.png is a genuine capture showing row 44 highlighted and visible in the same media path; the live post-jump bundle confirms it.

Candidate claims about conditional exposure, activation, folder retention, and row visibility are backed by extension reads, screenshot outputs, and the tap event in the contiguous session event trail.
An actual tap on void-folder:/opt/nothingness/media changed the folder, and previous/pause/resume/next playback controls responded while the app remained live.
After repeated jump/navigation/playback checks, the app remained responsive and final runtime reported zero overflow/error reports.
